# Test papers / 测试论文

The PDFs in this directory are pages taken from three arXiv papers. Each paper is licensed under [Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0)](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/); the license is recorded in the PDF metadata of the papers. All credit for the papers belongs to their authors.

这个目录里的 PDF 是从下面三篇 arXiv 论文中按页抽出的。三篇论文都采用[知识共享署名 4.0 国际许可（CC BY 4.0）](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/)，许可证写在论文 PDF 的元数据里。论文的全部功劳属于其作者。

| Paper | Authors | arXiv | License |
|---|---|---|---|
| AutoDesign: Meta-Harness Optimization for Long-Horizon Agentic Design | Yaxin Luo, Haobin Jiang, Jialv Zou, Xu Huang, Wenhao Yan, Haodong Li, Zhengrong Yue, Jing Li, Xiaofu Chen, Xiaohan Zhao, Jiacheng Liu, Jiacheng Cui, Zhiqiang Shen, Xiaotong Li | [2608.13560v1](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.13560v1) | [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/) |
| AutoRef: Harness Optimization for Agentic Multi-Reference Image Generation | Yuta Oshima, Ku Onoda, Yusuke Iwasawa, Masahiro Suzuki, Yutaka Matsuo, Hiroki Furuta | [2609.35530v1](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35530v1) | [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/) |
| MaLiang-Harness: A Programmable Path to Image and Video Generation | Haoyu Zhao, Zihao Zhang, Xudong Wang, Jiaxi Gu, Zuxuan Wu, Yu-Gang Jiang, Shuicheng Yan | [2609.34309v1](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34309v1) | [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/) |

## Changes / 改动

The files were made by extracting whole pages from the papers (v1 as published on arXiv). The content of each page is not changed: its text, its layout and its graphics are the paper's own. Only the choice of pages is ours; some files no longer carry the paper's PDF metadata (title, authors, license), which is why this table lists, for every file, which paper and which pages of it the file holds.

这些文件是从论文（arXiv 上发布的 v1）中整页抽出的，页面内容没有改动：文字、版面和图形都是论文原样，只有页的选取是我们做的。有些文件不再带论文 PDF 的元数据（标题、作者、许可证），所以下表逐个列出每个文件属于哪篇论文、是论文的哪几页。
